query: How will vendors and procurement be handled?
response:
Vendors and procurement will be handled by:
- Working with vendors to protect USDA data, especially PII, and proactively addressing impacts related to ethics, integrity, and bias (Document 1).
- Incorporating standardized contract language in service and supply contracts to uphold USDA AI policies (Document 1).
- Reviewing Generative AI in commercial software and updating processes and policies as needed (Document 1).
- Educating contracting officers on industry developments in AI to assist with holistic AI contract reviews (Document 1).
- Encouraging vendors to adopt minimum standard feature sets from NIST and USDA (Document 1).
- Coordinating acquisition plans and solicitations with the Chief AI Officer (CAIO) for GSA-funded procurements (Document 2).
- Ensuring requirements documents (PWS/SOO/SOW) are coordinated and approved by the CAIO before releasing solicitations (Document 2).
- Promoting competition in federal procurement of AI by preferencing interoperable AI products and services (Document 4).
- Requiring sufficient post-award monitoring and evaluation of the effectiveness of procured AI (Document 4).
